observations.body: The psalm places the LORD’s anointed against the nations’ resistance and reports the decree, “You are my son.”
observations.label: The installed king is addressed as son: action

observations.body: The king receives the nations, while rulers are warned to serve and take refuge.

payload.tension: The psalm’s royal setting must remain visible when its son-language is heard beside the mountain voice.
